# PAO Symbol

> Free SVG vector downloads of the Period After Opening (PAO) symbol used on cosmetic product packaging. No attribution required.

## What is the PAO Symbol?

The Period After Opening (PAO) symbol is a regulatory symbol found on cosmetic and personal care product packaging. It looks like an open jar with a number and the letter "M" (for months) printed on it. The number indicates how many months a product remains safe and effective after it has been opened for the first time.

The PAO symbol is required under EU Cosmetics Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 for products with a shelf life greater than 30 months. It is also widely used on US cosmetic products as a best practice.

## Downloads Available

All files are SVG format, free to use with no attribution required.

- **Blank PAO** — No duration filled in, suitable for custom labeling: https://paosymbol.com/pao.svg
- **12M PAO** — 12-month use period: https://paosymbol.com/pao12.svg
- **24M PAO** — 24-month use period: https://paosymbol.com/pao24.svg
- **36M PAO** — 36-month use period: https://paosymbol.com/pao36.svg

## Usage

These SVG files can be used freely on:
- Cosmetic product labels
- Packaging design files
- Product documentation
- Brand guidelines

No attribution is required. The vectors are clean, scalable, and print-ready.
